title: My kitten stole my cheeseburger!
text: My kitten stole my cheeseburger🧀🍔! https://t.co/S3K81HdAeP
blurb: Caught red-pawed: this fluffy white cat reportedly swiped their human's cheeseburger and is wearing the evidence, a tiny smear of yellow cheese on the cheek, while looking utterly unbothered about it.
